- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:289-291 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_replay_rate_limited_clarify` posts "/reclarify [auto-requeued-by-poller]\n<!-- ai:clarify-rate-limit-replay:v1 run=${run} -->". clarify.yml `clarify_route` does not recognise this as an automated replay shape (it knows only `ai:reclarify-replay:v1 source=` at line 853 and the capacity-wait shape at lines 920-921), so every replay is classed as a human forced /reclarify with IS_FORCED_RECLARIFY=true.
  WHY: Each replay skips the orchestrator_fast_path defer at clarify.yml line 987 and loses automated-release semantics (source=0 issue-opened runs, pr-dependency-released, partial-delivery-restart, capacity-wait). It also appends `<!-- ai:clarification-human-answer -->` (lines 2350/2368), so orchestrate_clarify_respond skips auto-answering and the issue stalls until a human answers. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:326-332 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `replay_failed_reclarify_commands`, the newest-marker routing (`max_by(.id) | ... startswith("<!-- ai:clarify-rate-limited:v1 ")`) sends a rate-limited PAT release comment (pr-dependency-released / partial-delivery-restart) to `_replay_rate_limited_clarify`. Before this change, that comment took the existing #7328/#7657 `ai:reclarify-replay:v1 source=N` path.
  WHY: The rate-limited marker is posted after the "Queue failed reclarify for poller" marker, so it wins. The release then replays as a forced human /reclarify instead of `verified_replay` with gate=pr_dependency_release or partial_delivery_restart, which breaks backward compatibility with the existing release contract. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:236-286 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The clarify escalation in `_replay_rate_limited_clarify` (lines 273-286) posts the `<!-- ai:clarify-rate-limit-escalated:v1 run=${run} -->` marker even when adding `ai:needs-human` failed (`label_state="failed"`).
  WHY: On the next tick the already_requeued check (lines 236-242) matches the escalation marker and removes `ai:reclarify-requeue`. The label add is never retried, so the issue is left with neither a requeue label nor `ai:needs-human` and nothing re-drives it. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40427-40497 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR escalation in `run_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_pass` (lines 40487-40497) posts the escalation comment whatever `label_state` is, including when the `ai:needs-human` label write failed.
  WHY: On the next tick `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide` returns `already_escalated` (line 40428) and never retries. The PR has no `ai:needs-human`, and the comment wrongly says the label was added. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40425-40521 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A successful `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` (rc=0) is counted only through the requeue-marker comment posted after it (`gate_retry` markers counted at line 40425). If that POST fails (`marker=write_failed`, lines 40519-40520), the attempt is not counted.
  WHY: Each failed marker write allows one more re-dispatch beyond RATE_LIMIT_REQUEUE_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3, and repeated failures allow unbounded re-dispatch. Reviewers disagree on severity: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 3), the other four MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40434 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `waiting_for_reset` branch of `_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide` trusts the gate marker's reset epoch without a cap. The clarify path clamps it to created_epoch+3900.
  WHY: A forged, skewed or malformed far-future reset in a job-token gate marker keeps the PR in waiting_for_reset indefinitely, so it is never re-dispatched or escalated. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1) and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 2) raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The review gate requeue pass is said to have no head-pattern exclusion for orchestrator/project-* PRs.
  WHY: The reported effect is that reviews are re-dispatched for integration-ref managed PRs, bypassing the integration self-heal path. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state that the batch filter at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 39185-39188 already excludes these PRs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40429 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `later_review` check (`$login` or "github-actions" author after the gate marker) matches the PAT-authored failure comment that .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6235-6250 / scripts/review_autofix_step_failure_comment.sh:88 posts after every gate rc=75 failure.
  WHY: Every rate-limited PR would then return `skipped|later_review` permanently, so the PR-side requeue goal can never be reached. Rated BLOCKER. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected a similar `later_review` claim, saying the failure-comment steps are in the `codex-agent` job (review_autofix.yml line 6097 onward), which does not run when the `gate` job fails.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (with .github/workflows/clarify.yml):289-291 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The replay body "/reclarify [auto-requeued-by-poller]" + "<!-- ai:clarify-rate-limit-replay:v1 run=${run} -->" is not an automated shape that clarify_route verifies (lines 812-818, 853, 920-921, 987, 2350/2368). It is treated as a human forced /reclarify in three cases: (a) a source=0 orchestrator-managed issue, (b) PAT pr-dependency-released or partial-delivery-restart comments, (c) capacity-wait replays with source=none.
  WHY: is_forced_reclarify=true adds `<!-- ai:clarification-human-answer -->` and orchestrate_clarify_respond skips the issue, giving an idle stall. For (a), clarify also runs on an issue the orchestrator fast path owns.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:326-332 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In `replay_failed_reclarify_commands`, the newer rate-limited marker overrides the existing #7328/#7657 `ai:reclarify-replay:v1 source=N` path for a rate-limited PAT release comment.
  WHY: Before this PR the release replayed with release semantics (auto-answered). Now it replays as a forced human /reclarify.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40509-40520 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The requeue marker is posted only after `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts` succeeds. A failed POST logs only `marker=write_failed`, and the attempt is not counted.
  WHY: Each failed write grants one extra re-dispatch beyond RATE_LIMIT_REQUEUE_MAX_ATTEMPTS. Impact is bounded by how often writes fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:274-284, 236-241, 40488-40497 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both escalation paths write the terminal escalation marker even when adding `ai:needs-human` failed.
  WHY: Clarify: already_requeued matches and removes `ai:reclarify-requeue`. PR: `already_escalated` is returned and the comment claims the label was added. In both cases the item is left idle with no label.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:40434 (hardening) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The PR path does not cap the marker reset (the clarify path caps it at created_at+3900, line 249).
  WHY: A far-future reset keeps the PR in waiting_for_reset forever and it never escalates.
- (rejected pass-1 items, 3 related items): the orchestrator/project-* claim is refuted by lines 39185-39188; the shellcheck failure was not traced to any new line (CI failed_count 0); the `later_review` false positive does not apply because the failure-comment steps are in the `codex-agent` job (review_autofix.yml line 6097 onward), not in the gate job (lines 338-842).

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_review_gate_rate_limit_requeue_decide | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The review gate requeue pass has no head-pattern exclusion for orchestrator/project-* PRs.
  WHY: It re-dispatches reviews for integration-ref managed PRs, bypassing the integration self-heal path and causing conflicts.
